review:
Frozen Fruit is a classic 5x3 fruit slot whose bonus expands to six grids. Landing three free spins ice cubes on reels 1, 3 and 5 starts a pre-bonus round that sets up your free spins at random.

You can influence the pre-bonus with feature bets and a Respin All button, much like Hottest 666, then play the bonus with Wild Rain across multiple grids. The bonus can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 6,600x maximum and a 96% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 150 spins. A frosty fruit sibling of Hottest 666.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 150 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
